status: published summary inputs; no reconstructed likelihood or joint fit
disclosure: Public headline energies and timing bounds were known during target selection. These are not blind validation or independent predictions of the model.

survival.title: Exploring Lorentz Invariance Violation from Ultra-high-energy Gamma Rays Observed by LHAASO
survival.items: sections II-V; Table I, PDF page 6; equation (2), PDF page 3
survival.forward_model: Reconstructed air-shower spectrum; source spectral forms, energy response, backgrounds and sharp high-energy cutoff; Poisson forward folding and CLs simulation.
survival.limitations: Published cutoff summaries only. Counts, detector response and joint covariance are not supplied here. Electron-modified decay and shower response are not the paper's photon-only model.
survival.source_discrepancy: Equation (2) prints H(E-Ecut), opposite the high-energy cutoff described in the text and the Ecut=infinity null. The reported table is transcribed; the likelihood is not reproduced.

timing.title: Stringent Tests of Lorentz Invariance Violation from LHAASO Observations of GRB 221009A
timing.forward_model: Evolving GRB afterglow, EBL attenuation, detector response and FLRW propagation; bias calibration by shuffled data.
timing.limitations: One published subluminal quadratic bound is used. It is not combined with the calibrated or CCF intervals or turned into a Gaussian likelihood. The quoted 6.9e11 GeV value agrees with v2.

codata.title: NIST 2022 CODATA recommended values, current database on access date
codata.items: electron mass energy equivalent in MeV; fine-structure constant; inverse fine-structure constant; SI defining constants
codata.limitations: Adjusted parameters, not raw direct measurements. Correlations are not reproduced here; no joint calibration likelihood is formed.

data.type: model-dependent 95 percent lower confidence bound on spectral cutoff
data.uncertainty_interpretation: Quoted systematic uncertainty of the bound; not an event energy error or Gaussian standard deviation.
data.covariance: not available; not combined with Crab as independent likelihood
data.applicability: Only a conditional sensitivity envelope until the candidate's attenuation and air-shower response have been mapped.

data.type: model-dependent 95 percent lower confidence bound on spectral cutoff
data.uncertainty_interpretation: Quoted systematic uncertainty of the bound, not an independent observation.
data.covariance: shared detector and spectral-model systematics; joint covariance not available
data.applicability: Same conditional response requirement as J2032.

data.type: reconstructed highest photon-candidate energy in Table I
data.uncertainty: No event-specific uncertainty used here. The quoted approximately 8.5 percent PeV resolution applies to zenith below 20 degrees, not automatically to this event.
data.covariance: overlaps J2032 cutoff data; never counted twice

data.uncertainty: No distribution assigned; used only to compare a conditional rate with an astronomical flight length.

data.type: published 95 percent lower bound, ML MINOS quadratic subluminal case
data.uncertainty: One-sided model-dependent bound; no Gaussian error or raw likelihood inferred.
data.covariance: One analysis of one event; alternative calibration/CCF rows are not independent data.

data.type: flat LambdaCDM convention in the published timing extraction
data.uncertainty: Fixed by that extraction; no independent cosmological fit performed.

data.scale_scheme: physical rest energy; not a bare lattice mass or an MSbar running parameter
data.covariance: CODATA correlated adjustment; threshold sensitivity uses this datum alone.

data.scale_scheme: explicit tree-level coupling calibration; running and matching corrections not computed
data.covariance: Not assumed independent of electron calibration in a statistical fit.

selection_and_complexity.continuous_model_choices: A common cutoff and shared lattice orientation; calibrated mass/speed/coupling are supplied. Renormalized speed protection and species identification are unresolved, not free results.
selection_and_complexity.ranking_rule: Prefer the simpler null while no cross-family improvement over it is established. Do not assign BIC, Bayes factors or joint confidence regions without a likelihood and identifiable nuisance model.
